title: Warehouse bin transfers: one lock per bin, taken in a fixed order
name: Warehouse bin transfers

questions.prompt: A picker on the warehouse floor scanned the same bin for both 'from' and 'to' while rearranging a shelf. That request never returned, and afterwards every other request touching that bin hung as well until the service was restarted. Transfers between two different bins, even opposite ones at the same time, have always been fine. Fix Registry.Move so the tests pass, keeping one lock per bin.
